properties.statement: Wrote a script that proves a storage-engine dependency bump is safe on real stores: copies each local store four times (with its identity sidecars), exports two copies with the released binary as a control, one with the new build (forward), and on the fourth writes a probe record with the new build then reads it back with the released binary (rollback), comparing node and edge counts and the export content hash; then read each table file's footer to confirm the new engine actually wrote its newer format. The accepted dependency-currency rule now asks for exactly this proof on any bump that touches stored data, and nothing in reflow2 runs it.
